title: Streetlights out along the railway underpass
description: Four of the six lights inside the underpass have been dark for about ten days. Walking through after 7pm is unsafe, especially for people coming back from the station.
ai_summary: Four streetlights inside the railway underpass have been non-functional for ten days, creating safety concerns after dark.

title: Water pipe leaking at the junction
description: Clean water has been leaking from a cracked pipe at the corner since Monday. The road is always wet and a puddle is forming near the bus stop.
ai_summary: A cracked pipe is leaking clean water, causing the road to remain wet and forming a puddle near a bus stop.

title: Storm drain blocked after the rain
description: The drain in front of the vegetable market is choked with plastic and silt. After last night's rain the water stood ankle-deep on the road for hours.
ai_summary: A storm drain is blocked by plastic and silt, causing water to accumulate on the road.

title: Cluster of potholes on the service road
description: Three potholes next to each other on the service road. Two-wheelers swerve into traffic to avoid them, and one rider fell yesterday evening.
location: Service road beside the flyover, Outer Ring Road
ai_summary: Three potholes on the service road are causing vehicles to swerve into traffic and have resulted in a rider falling.

title: Construction waste dumped on an empty plot
description: Someone has been dumping broken tiles, cement bags and household garbage on the empty plot. It has started to smell and stray dogs are pulling the bags onto the street.
ai_summary: Construction waste and household garbage are being dumped on an empty plot, causing odors and attracting stray dogs.

title: Broken footpath slabs outside the school
description: Several footpath slabs are cracked and tilted outside the primary school gate. Children have to walk on the road at drop-off time.
ai_summary: Cracked and tilted footpath slabs near a school gate force pedestrians to walk on the road.

title: Very low water pressure in the evenings
description: For two weeks the water pressure drops to a trickle between 6pm and 9pm. Upper floors get almost no water during that time.
ai_summary: Water pressure drops significantly in the evenings, affecting upper floors.

title: Flickering light at the park entrance
description: The lamp post at the main entrance of the park flickers on and off all night. It is not fully dark yet, but the path is hard to see.
ai_summary: A lamp post at the park entrance is flickering, making the path difficult to see.
